description: One call with the figures for a single S-Bill on The Standard Reserve (TSR), on Robinhood Chain: the bill's record, the live S-Bills state, and a block that depends on the bill's state. An active bill gets the exact payout of an exit now (measured), the premium an early exit gives up, and the exit fee for each coming day until the fee stops changing or the bill matures (derived; the response states its assumption). A matured bill gets the redeem payout (measured) and what rolling it would lock (derived), and notes that nothing rolls automatically, so a matured bill earns nothing more until its owner redeems or rolls it. Exited and redeemed bills return the record only. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error). An unknown bill id returns 404. Requires bill_id. It returns inputs only and does not recommend an action.

bill_id.description: The S-Bills bill id, a positive integer as a string (for example "1").
